rationale: The full MAA notice identifies its current position, directs certified-air-system applicants to raise an MCRI for MAA agreement, and recommends supervised training that produces models fixed for integration and use in a defined operational-design domain. The claim preserves the notice's applicant-specific UK-military scope.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-001-R1 — PDF pp. 1–2, Scope, Implementation and Background
S-CHAL-001-R2 — PDF pp. 2–3, Certified Air Systems
limitations: This is informative UK military guidance, not a completed MCRI, civil-airworthiness approval or product safety case.
The recommendation does not establish that a particular model or operation is safe.
